statement: {f} {L c} (hf : FunLimAt f L c) (x : ℕ → ℝ) (a✝ : ∀ n, x n ≠ c) (a✝ : SeqLim x c) : SeqLim (fun n => f (x n)) L
name: SeqLim_of_FunLimAt
content: If a function `f` has limit `L` at point `c`, then for every sequence `(xₙ)` converging to `c` with `xₙ ≠ c`, the sequence `f(xₙ)` converges to `L`.
